national.headline: Ordinances Curtail Privileges of KP Lawmakers
national.line: President Zardari promulgated five ordinances withdrawing several MPAs' privileges, including immunity against preventive detention.

national.headline: Security Forces Kill 15 Terrorists in Mastung
national.line: Security forces eliminated 15 terrorists during two separate intelligence-based operations in Balochistan's Mastung district.

national.headline: Pakistan Improves Ranking in UN E-Governance Index
national.line: Pakistan jumped 17 places to rank 119th in the United Nations E-Government Development Index for 2026.

national.headline: FCC Curbs Provincial Takeover of Federal Powers
national.line: The Federal Constitutional Court ruled that unexercised federal fiscal authorities do not automatically transfer to provincial control under Article 142.

national.headline: ECC Approves Export of 416,000 Tonnes of Sugar
national.line: The Economic Coordination Committee approved exporting 416,000 tonnes of sugar despite missing an agreed IMF deregulation benchmark.

national.headline: CDWP Clears Major Development Projects
national.line: The CDWP cleared development projects valued at Rs19.3 billion and forwarded schemes worth Rs172.4 billion to ECNEC for approval.

international.headline: Pakistan Labels Climate Change Major Threat at SCO
international.line: Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik urged regional cooperation against global warming during a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation meeting in New Delhi.

international.headline: EU Proposes Big Tech Levy to Fund Budget
international.line: The European Union presented plans to tax major global digital firms to finance its upcoming budget amid internal fiscal divisions.

international.headline: China Seeks UNSC Sanctions Against BLA
international.line: China called on UN Security Council members to sanction the Balochistan Liberation Army and its Majeed Brigade without political considerations.

international.headline: US Sentences Indian Man in Sikh Assassination Plot
international.line: A US court handed Nikhil Gupta nearly 20 years in prison for participating in an Indian-directed plot to murder a Sikh activist.

international.headline: UN Envoys Agree on Path Toward Autonomous Weapons Rules
international.line: Countries reached a preliminary consensus at the United Nations to pursue regulations governing lethal autonomous weapons systems.

international.headline: COP31 Climate Talks Stalled Over Fossil Fuel Language
international.line: UN COP31 negotiations went into overtime after a revised draft agreement omitted commitments on phasing out fossil fuels.
